questions.explanation: Bayes' rule for events with positive probabilities is $P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)P(A)}{P(B)}$.
questions.source_support: The definition states $P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)P(A)}{P(B)}$.
